purpose: ONS Consumer Trends household final consumption expenditure, current prices, annual (30 June 2026 release). The seven specific series, 2020 to 2025: COICOP 04.5 and its sub-classes 04.5.1 to 04.5.4, 07.2.2 fuels and lubricants for personal transport and 07.3.2 passenger transport by road, all on the domestic concept. For 2023 to 2025: the national (NAT0) and domestic (0) totals and the twelve domestic divisions from the overview sheet, and the three classes a household diary does not record (02.3 narcotics, 04.2 imputed rentals, 12.6.1 FISIM). Consumed by the lcfs_consumption road-fuel level (07.2.2, microcosm#1113) and the division-capture diagnostic.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
